result:
Lane finished, PR #205 ready.

**Why attempt 1 didn't finish:** it was waiting — CI was `IN_PROGRESS` and arm B hadn't landed — and left the PR in draft with a `[lane.blendarm50] waiting:` comment. That's now recorded at the top of the new NOTES.md section.

**What resolved:**

| signal | outcome |
|---|---|
| CI on `e70b6d37c7` | GREEN (two `build`, both SUCCESS) |
| arm B `1789963700-blendarm50-1474765` | **killed by the owner at 88 min** — no verdict |

The arm's `ERROR` marker is the owner's own: a side quest no longer being pursued, left by another agent, asked to be stopped. The owner also hand-wrote `$WORK/arms/skipped/8d1ea561…` — necessary because `arms.sh` counts an ERRORed result as "not a run" (`arms.sh:292,310`) and would have re-queued the same 90-minute pair — ending "Do NOT delete this file to 'fix' a missing measurement for #50: the absence is deliberate."

So the PR ends with a registered prediction on live refs that will never be judged. Not `PRE-REGISTERED`, not a FAIL — I wrote that state plainly rather than manufacturing a verdict.

**The one judgement call:** `result.json` shows runs 1 and 2 at 1673/1673 with `partial: false` — two complete capture sets that would have answered the question. I did not score them. The `ERROR` file rules out the directory and the owner ruled out the question; scoring two thirds of a killed arm answers it regardless. NOTES.md says the subset exists and was not used, so the next lane doesn't rediscover it and quietly decide otherwise, and attempt 1's `ab_compare` recipe is marked superseded in place rather than left to be followed.

The lane's substantive result never depended on arm B and is unchanged: `771c8eb4f1` does not move stack C (1115–1119/1120 against aliasing, control pinned at 1/1120) and could not have. What stays deliberately unmeasured is whether any of the 1,193 commits since `49afee8889` moves it.

Merged `origin/master` (clean, no file overlap), preflight passed, pushed `f81f0eca06`, PR body PATCHed and read back with `Files:` matching the diff, comments posted on #205 and #50, PR marked ready. CI re-runs on this head — write-up plus the merge, no code change from the green head — and I'm not waiting on it.
